trigger.displayed_consumption_rule: reported aggressor size >= pre-event opposing top size and trade price touches or crosses that level

execution.entry: decision-time ask limit; fill only if arrival touch survives; size capped by displayed ask
execution.fee: per-token CLOB /fee-rate coefficient applied to both taker legs
execution.fidelity: L3 public event-time touch; no order acknowledgement

evaluation.promotion_rule: No live path. Freeze a new eval manifest only if the continuation arm beats the fade control and has a positive clustered lower confidence bound after exact round-trip fees under measured latency.
evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across both arms, all latency profiles, four horizons, and the existing BORG hypothesis family.
